title: A2UI v0.9 Ad & Sponsored Components Extension Catalog
description: Custom extension catalog defining AdBanner and real-time contextual SponsoredCard components for A2UI v0.9 surfaces.

AdBanner.description: A high-visibility sponsored banner supporting mandatory advertiser disclosure and trackable action clicks.

sponsorName.description: Brand or entity funding the advertisement.

headline.description: Primary promotional message or value proposition.

bodyText.description: Optional secondary promotional description, offer details, or terms.

ctaLabel.description: Action button text such as 'Claim Credits' or 'Learn More'.

mediaUrl.description: Optional HTTPS URL to a banner graphic or brand emblem.

onClickAction.description: A2UI Action dispatched when user clicks the banner or CTA button.

badgeColor.description: Optional CSS color or token string for the disclosure badge.

SponsoredCard.description: A real-time contextual sponsored card designed for search result grids and multi-ad card layouts.

headline.description: Promotional headline dynamically tailored to the user's search query.

bodyText.description: Promotional value proposition or offer details.

ctaLabel.description: Call to action label (e.g. 'Claim ₹5,000 Credit', 'Deploy Instance').

mediaUrl.description: Optional HTTPS URL to sponsor logo or creative asset.

badgeText.description: Optional promotional pill badge (e.g., 'Lowest Cost/hr', 'Instant Deploy').

clearingPrice.description: Real-time second-price auction clearing CPM in INR.

onClickAction.description: A2UI Action dispatched when user clicks the card or CTA button.
